backend/main.mo: Defines product, order, and export inquiry types and manages creation, storage, and initialization of product catalog in a Motoko actor.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence entries mapping requested features to affected frontend files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides short descriptive summaries of all major frontend files for documentation or build planning.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base style layer defining OKLCH color variables and light/dark mode theme tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that mounts the React app and loads the main TypeScript bundle.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes, initializes backend catalog on load, and wraps the app in theme and cart providers.
frontend/src/components/ExportInquiryFor: Form component for submitting export inquiries with validation, mutation handling, and optional inline success state.
frontend/src/components/OwnerGate.tsx: Gate component that checks owner-mode state and either renders protected content or prompts to enable owner access.
frontend/src/components/ProcessPicture.t: Displays a product image with variant sizing and falls back to a placeholder if no picture is available.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Renders a product card with image, category, description, price, and link to the details page.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Provides the site footer with company info, quick links, social icons, and a WhatsApp contact link.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Implements the site header with navigation, cart access, WhatsApp link, and a mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/SiteLayout.tsx: Wraps the page layout with a header, main content area, and footer.
frontend/src/context/CartContext.tsx: Manages cart state with add, update, remove, and persistence via localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useExportInquiry.ts: Provides a mutation for submitting export inquiries through the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication, identity persistence, and login state management.
frontend/src/hooks/useOrders.ts: Provides a mutation for placing orders and invalidates order queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useOwnerData.ts: Fetches all orders or export inquiries using the authenticated backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Fetches products, products by category, and product categories from the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS base styles and custom color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/lib/cart.ts: Implements cart item type and utilities for adding, updating, removing items, counting items, and calculating cart totals.
frontend/src/lib/ownerMode.ts: Handles enabling, disabling, and checking owner mode using localStorage.
frontend/src/lib/processPictures.ts: Maps backend product process image filenames to corresponding generated static asset paths.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Displays the shopping cart with item editing, removal, and an order summary.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Renders checkout form, validates input, submits orders, and clears the cart on success.
frontend/src/pages/ExportInquiryPage.tsx: Shows an export inquiry form and a confirmation message after submission.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page showcasing products, hero banner, benefits, and export inquiry entry points.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Displays order confirmation details including order ID with navigation options.
frontend/src/pages/OwnerPage.tsx: Owner dashboard page listing all orders with details via dialogs and using data hooks for orders and export inquiries.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetailPage.tsx: Displays full product information, pricing, images, and allows adding items to the cart using URL-based product lookup.
frontend/src/pages/ShopPage.tsx: Shop listing page showing products with category filtering, loading state, and responsive grid layout.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, fonts, animations, container settings, and enabling typography and container-query plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing site purpose, features, versions, known issues, and required image assets.
